notes: Modified cash basis; the fund statements carry capital assets, debt and depreciation. Governmental lines from the Total column of the governmental funds statement (p4), which lists spending by object only (object lines take general government with review; interest/fees as Debt Service). Fund balance roll-forward: beginning 793,082 (printed 'NET POSITION, beginning of year') + restatement 2,779,884 (adjustment, as printed) = 3,572,966; ending 3,657,865 (p4). No governmental beginning cash printed (p8 prints only all-funds budgetary cash 1,350,291); ending cash from the Statement of Net Position governmental column (p1): cash 164,935 + county treasurer 5,414; CDs 258,160 in ending_investments. The governmental funds balance sheet (p3) shows cash 822,046 less 'Deficit cash and equity in pooled cash' 657,111 liability; its totals differ from the government-wide figures, so the balance sheet is the Statement of Net Position (p1). Business-type from the proprietary statement (p6; Water, Sewer, Garbage, Keno columns), measure net position, restatement (2,951) recorded as beginning_as_previously_reported/restatement; totals = operating + nonoperating. The only supplementary schedule is the all-funds budgetary statement (pp7-8), so detail is per fund column of the governmental and proprietary fund statements. Read pages 1-8 of 8
